es: Responder a un dilema con una estructura clara (postura, razón, ejemplo y matiz) y manejar una pregunta inesperada ganando tiempo con naturalidad.

teaching.en: To begin with, I would accept the sponsor, because the club needs new equipment.
teaching.es: Para empezar, aceptaría al patrocinador, porque el club necesita equipo nuevo.
teaching.explanationEs: Abre con tu postura: To begin with / My position is… Después da la razón con because.
segments: To begin with, I would accept the
sponsor, because the club needs new equipment.
teaching.audioText: To begin with, I would accept the sponsor, because the club needs new equipment.

teaching.en: On balance, the benefits outweigh the risks, although I see the dilemma.
teaching.es: En conjunto, los beneficios superan los riesgos, aunque veo el dilema.
teaching.explanationEs: On balance = sopesándolo todo. Abre una postura matizada y reconoce el otro lado.
segments: On balance, the benefits outweigh the
risks, although I see the dilemma.
teaching.audioText: On balance, the benefits outweigh the risks, although I see the dilemma.

teaching.en: For instance, other clubs have asked sponsors to pay only for the equipment.
teaching.es: Por ejemplo, otros clubes han pedido a los patrocinadores que paguen solo el equipo.
teaching.explanationEs: For instance introduce un ejemplo concreto que apoya tu razón.
segments: For instance, other clubs have asked sponsors
to pay only for the equipment.
teaching.audioText: For instance, other clubs have asked sponsors to pay only for the equipment.

teaching.en: That is a fair point; I had not considered it, but I would say the choice is still ours.
teaching.es: Es una buena observación; no lo había considerado, pero diría que la decisión sigue siendo nuestra.
teaching.explanationEs: Ante una pregunta inesperada: reconoce el punto (That is a fair point) y responde.
segments: That is a fair point; I had not considered it,
but I would say the choice is still ours.
teaching.audioText: That is a fair point; I had not considered it, but I would say the choice is still ours.

teaching.en: If the question is unexpected, buy time: Let me think for a moment.
teaching.es: Si la pregunta es inesperada, gana tiempo: Déjame pensar un momento.
teaching.explanationEs: Let me + verbo sin to. Una pausa natural vale más que una respuesta improvisada.
segments: If the question is unexpected, buy time:
Let me think for a moment.
teaching.audioText: If the question is unexpected, buy time: Let me think for a moment.

teaching.en: That said, I would set one condition: the sponsor cannot choose our team colours.
teaching.es: Dicho esto, pondría una condición: el patrocinador no puede elegir los colores del equipo.
teaching.explanationEs: That said añade un matiz o condición sin cambiar tu postura.
segments: That said, I would set one condition:
the sponsor cannot choose our team colours.
teaching.audioText: That said, I would set one condition: the sponsor cannot choose our team colours.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase abre la respuesta con una postura clara?

choices.text: To begin with, I would accept the sponsor.
Well, it is a question, I think.
I do not know what to say.

feedback.es: «To begin with, I would accept the sponsor» da la postura en la primera frase. Las otras dos no dicen qué opina el hablante.

hint.es: La postura debe aparecer en la primera frase.

origin.text: Question: Would you accept a sponsor for the school club?

prompt.es: Completa: «Por ejemplo, las redes están rotas.»

feedback.es: For instance abre un ejemplo concreto que apoya la razón, con la preposición for.

hint.es: Es la preposición con la que empieza «por ejemplo».

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta gana tiempo y reconoce la pregunta?

choices.text: I do not want to answer that.
That is a fair point. Let me think for a moment.
Yes. No. Maybe. I do not know.

feedback.es: «That is a fair point. Let me think for a moment» reconoce la pregunta y pide una pausa natural. Las otras respuestas se cierran o se contradicen.

hint.es: Reconoce la pregunta y pide un momento con naturalidad.

origin.text: Interviewer: What would you do if the sponsor changed the name of the club?

prompt.es: Ordena: «Déjame pensar un momento antes de responder.»

answer.text: Let me think for a moment before I answer

feedback.es: Let me + verbo sin to: let me think. Después, for a moment y before I answer completan la frase.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué estructura sigue la respuesta.

choices.text: Only an example with no position.
A question followed by silence.
Position, reason and a condition that adds nuance.

feedback.es: La respuesta da una postura (I would say yes), una razón (the club needs new balls) y un matiz con That said: una condición.

origin.audio: On balance, I would say yes. The club needs new balls, and the money is important. That said, I would ask for one condition.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada fórmula con su función en la respuesta.

pairs.es: Añade un matiz sin cambiar la postura
Gana tiempo ante una pregunta difícil

feedback.es: Cada fórmula tiene su lugar: abrir con la postura, dar un ejemplo, añadir un matiz y ganar tiempo.

prompt.es: Responde al dilema como si hablaras dos minutos y contesta a la pregunta inesperada.

answer.text: To begin with, I would accept the sponsor, because our club needs new equipment and the school cannot pay for it. For instance, the nets are broken, and the balls are old. On balance, I think the benefits outweigh the risks, although I see the dilemma: the café sells sweet drinks, and our club is about health. That said, I would set two conditions. First, the café must also sell water and fruit at our events. Second, the sponsor cannot decide anything about the team. As for your question about the logo, that is a fair point. Let me think for a moment. I would accept a small logo on the shirts, provided that the players agree and the logo stays small. In short, I would say yes, but only with clear limits.
accepted: To begin with, I would accept the sponsor, because our club needs new equipment and the school cannot pay for it. For instance, the nets are broken, and the balls are old. On balance, I think the benefits outweigh the risks, although I see the dilemma: the café sells sweet drinks, and our club is about health. That said, I would set two conditions. First, the café must also sell water and fruit at our events. Second, the sponsor cannot decide anything about the team. As for your question about the logo, that is a fair point. Let me think for a moment. I would accept a small logo on the shirts, provided that the players agree and the logo stays small. In short, I would say yes, but only with clear limits.

My position is that we should accept the money. The club is small, and it needs new equipment. For example, we have only one good ball, and the shirts are very old. The school cannot pay for new things, so the help of a sponsor is important to us. Although the café sells sweet drinks, we can ask it to offer water as well. That said, I would want a written agreement, because the sponsor should not choose our team. About the logo, good question. Let me think. I would accept it on the shirts, as long as the players agree. I would also ask the players and the families for their opinion before we sign anything. Overall, I would say yes, with clear limits.

feedback.es: Una respuesta completa da la postura, la razón con un ejemplo, un matiz con condiciones y contesta la pregunta inesperada con calma y en la misma estructura.

origin.text: Dilema: un café local ofrece patrocinar el club deportivo de tu escuela, pero vende bebidas azucaradas. Responde como si hablaras durante dos minutos: postura, razón con ejemplo y matiz. Después contesta a la pregunta inesperada: «¿Y si el café quisiera poner su logotipo en las camisetas?»

prompt.es: Escucha y elige la postura y el matiz del hablante.

choices.text: He refuses the sponsor but suggests an alternative.
He accepts the sponsor without any condition.
He has no position and gives no example.

feedback.es: El hablante rechaza al patrocinador pero, con «However», propone una alternativa (una venta en la escuela): hay postura, ejemplo y matiz.

origin.audio: I would not accept the sponsor. The club is small, so the sponsor could have too much power. For instance, they might choose our uniforms. However, I understand the need for money, so I would suggest a school sale instead.

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta maneja mejor la pregunta inesperada?

choices.text: Yes. Half is half.
Good question. Let me think. I would say yes, provided that we find the other half.
I already answered that.

feedback.es: La primera reconoce la pregunta, gana tiempo y responde con matiz y una condición. Las otras dos cierran la conversación sin argumentar.

origin.text: Interviewer: You said you would accept. Would you still accept if the sponsor paid only half?

prompt.es: Completa tres fórmulas: apertura, balance y matiz.

feedback.es: To begin with abre la postura, On balance sopesa y That said añade el matiz.

sentences: To ___ with, I would accept the sponsor.
That ___, I would set one condition.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase responde con matiz en vez de con un sí o un no secos?

choices.text: Yes.
No.
I might, although I would listen to their reasons first.

feedback.es: «I might, although I would listen to their reasons first» da una postura y un matiz. Un sí o un no solos no muestran razonamiento.

origin.text: Question: Would you change your answer if your friends disagreed?

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hace el hablante antes de dar su respuesta.

choices.text: He acknowledges the point and buys time.
He changes the subject.
He asks the other person to answer.

feedback.es: El hablante reconoce el punto, pide un momento y solo después da su respuesta: gana tiempo de forma natural.

origin.audio: That is a fair point. Let me think for a moment. I would say no.

prompt.es: Reescribe con un matiz: «Yo aceptaría, pero pondría una condición.»
